official_name: Low-altitude target multi-band radar identification characteristic dataset
publisher: Journal of Signal Processing and ScienceDB
redistribution_policy: The article is CC-BY-3.0; the dataset redistribution right was not independently established, so raw files stay local.
grouping_risk: Batch codes collide across classes/models; random row split is forbidden.
decision_reason: Grouped X-band evidence is frozen; cross-band protocol is frozen but target results have not yet been viewed.
allowed_claim_scope: Within-release grouped category baselines and preregistered band-held-out transfer.
prohibited_claim_scope: Unseen-model; independent external blind; physical-Hz micro-Doppler; H/V polarimetry; balloon; Tian reproduction.

official_name: LSS-Ku-1.0 low-slow-small UAV detection dataset under ground clutter
redistribution_policy: Article access does not establish raw-data redistribution rights; no local copy was made.
representation: radar detection data; schema not locally audited
grouping_risk: The archive is large and grouping/session semantics are unknown until download and audit.
planned_use: Possible Tian-domain or ground-clutter detection gap only
decision_reason: The 14.88 GiB archive is not downloaded because it does not currently remove the Tian preprocessing and alignment blockers.
allowed_claim_scope: Source and schema assessment after a justified download.
prohibited_claim_scope: Tian reproduction; independent external detection; H/V polarimetry; balloon.

official_name: LSS-HSR-L holographic staring radar low-altitude target dataset
redistribution_policy: Raw data are local research inputs and are not redistributed in Git or share packages.
classes: four UAV types; single bird; bird flock; migratory bird; rotating fixed target; car
grouping_risk: Scene, track grouping and equivalence to the smaller journal bundle still require audit.
planned_use: Reference for the journal-bundle equivalence and later processed-spectrum/trajectory work
decision_reason: The ScienceDB V2 file tree is verified, but its 237,020,946-byte archive has not been downloaded.
allowed_claim_scope: Source-level description only until the V2 archive or bundle equivalence is audited.
prohibited_claim_scope: Raw IQ; H/V polarimetry; physical processing chain reconstruction; balloon; independent external deployment evidence.

official_name: LSS-HSR-L journal-hosted dataset and instructions bundle
redistribution_policy: The journal bundle's own redistribution terms and equivalence to ScienceDB V2 are not yet established; raw files stay local.
classes: four UAV types; single bird; bird flock; migratory bird; rotating fixed target; car
grouping_risk: The bundled dataset.py can move source files; release equivalence, scene and track grouping still require a read-only audit.
decision_reason: The 209,569,478-byte journal bundle is present and ZIP integrity passed, but it must not be represented as the 237,020,946-byte ScienceDB V2 artifact.
allowed_claim_scope: Bundle schema and split description after read-only audit.
prohibited_claim_scope: ScienceDB V2 equivalence; raw IQ; H/V polarimetry; physical processing chain reconstruction; balloon; independent external deployment evidence.

official_name: LSS-DAUR-1.0 digital array ubiquitous radar sea and air target detection dataset
redistribution_policy: Raw and repackaged data are not redistributed; only code, hashes, schema summaries and aggregate results may enter Git/share packages.
representation: 512-bin Doppler time sequence; candidate paired trajectory
classes: passenger ship; speedboat; helicopter; rotary UAV; bird; fixed-wing UAV
grouping_risk: The 77 tracks can be expanded into many windows, but windows from one track are not independent; canonical and backup_original files differ.
planned_use: PRF/time/pairing audit; track-grouped normalized-Doppler UAV-vs-bird; candidate trajectory features
decision_reason: All 314 files and total bytes match the official V3 release; physical axes, TD/TR pairing and modeling remain gated on full audit.
allowed_claim_scope: Within-release track-grouped normalized-Doppler/trajectory algorithm research only after preregistration and pairing audit.
prohibited_claim_scope: Physical-Hz claims before PRF/time audit; synchronized-feature claims before pairing audit; random frame/window split; independent deployment evidence; H/V polarimetry; balloon; redistribution of raw or transformed data.

official_name: LSS-FMCWR-2.0 low-altitude target K/L-band micro-Doppler dataset
redistribution_policy: Raw and repackaged data are not redistributed; derived-data release needs a separate ND review.
representation: FMCW echo MAT archives; micro-Doppler processing example
classes: M350; Inspire 2; Mavic 2; hexacopter; simulated bird; AC311 helicopter
grouping_risk: Official text says 90 groups while listed subtotals sum to 86; some L-band records may repeat because acquisition position did not change.
planned_use: K/L and aspect-angle micro-Doppler algorithm audit
decision_reason: All eight V4 files match official byte counts and all six RAR files match official MD5; RAR extraction/schema audit is pending.
allowed_claim_scope: Within-release target/angle/band analysis after group audit; simulated-bird results labeled as simulation.
prohibited_claim_scope: Natural-bird external evidence; random MAT/window split; H/V polarimetry; balloon; independent deployment evidence.

official_name: LSS-FMCWR-1.0 low-altitude UAV K/L-band micro-Doppler dataset

planned_use: Processing-chain reference and later complementary UAV study
decision_reason: Official instructions are local; the one-gigabyte body is deferred until FMCWR-2.0 audit identifies a concrete gap.
allowed_claim_scope: Processing-interface design only until raw archives are downloaded and audited.
prohibited_claim_scope: Performance claims; bird/background discrimination; H/V polarimetry; balloon.
